title: 2D Offset with Outside containment: the passes start inside and cut from the inside out, so the tool slots in the stock

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Main is broken or a regression with no workaround; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent

body:
The maintainer reported this in chat on 2026-11-22, in his own words:

> bug; Movement calcualtion; P2; Example 2D offset set with a outside continment, helixes dowwn inside of the calculated "containmen" and works its way from the inside out.. Which ends up being fully engagend slotting movements not following the rules where it should have been starting outside the part and worked itself in. We might need to add a option prob. undder "passes", that stats "Pass starts at <auto, inside, outside>".. where Auto is current behavior for setting it up and the other two forces either or. So we get control over the fact that it should not try to crate slots in the stock

## What happens

A 2D Offset operation has the containment "Outside". The tool helixes down inside the calculated containment. It then cuts the passes from the inside out. The result is fully engaged slotting moves in the stock.

## Expected

An "Outside" containment starts outside the part and works inward. The tool never makes a fully engaged slot in the stock.

## The change that the maintainer suggests

A new option on the Passes tab: "Pass starts at", with the values Auto, Inside and Outside.
- Auto keeps the current behaviour.
- Inside and Outside force the order.

The user then controls the order and stops the slots. This follows the rule that a strategy fork is an operation parameter with a default.

## Evidence

- Build v0.25.0, commit 7e2a8119 (built 2026-11-22 02:53 UTC). The maintainer sent a screenshot. It is not attached here.
- Operation `2D Offset1`: tool `EM-0800-4FL` (Ø8 end mill), model `fig8`, setup `Setup1`, machine VMC 3-AXIS, post Siemens 840D.
- The status line reads `OK - 8318 moves - 1 warning`. The warning reads: "feed moves 686 and 836 cross in XY at shared depth - repeated on 4 more moves (to 7496)". The operation tree shows 5 warnings.
- Lead in / Lead out tab: Entry type Helix, Helix radius 1.6 mm, Level to level "Same as entry", Between levels "Clearance plane", Between passes "Retract plane".
- The simulation at 60.7 / 1392.8 s shows the tool deep inside the machined area. The cut area around it is a closed slot.
- The maintainer's project file is a local file. Use the tracked model `testdata/models/fig8.step` and the tool `EM-0800-4FL` to reproduce.

## Possible link (not checked)

#2849, test 3 (`shoulder_adaptive::fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works`) uses the same model, the same tool and an "Outside" containment. Its body says that the last feed ends 31.406 mm from the part outline, and the PR #3267 says that a ring order change fixes it but turns `corner_arc_radius::the_crossing_law_keeps_the_arc_turns_and_crosses_nowhere` red. The two pins want opposite ring orders. A parameter for the order may settle both. The worker checks if this is the same defect and says so on both issues.

## Safety

A fully engaged slot overloads the tool. The toolpath is not a silent wrong cut, but it is a toolpath that the user must not run. If the fix changes pass order or the posted moves, it is under the safety floor: the pin goes red first, and the review is an independent Opus read with a hand trace.

Done means: a pin test shows an Outside containment that starts outside and cuts inward on `fig8.step` with `EM-0800-4FL`, with no move whose engagement is a full slot; the new option and its three values are in the property panel and in MCP; Auto keeps the current output of all shipped goldens.
